# clearInterval

[API index](../index)

```typescript
function clearInterval(handle: number): void;
```

Cancel future interval callbacks; an already started callback is not interrupted.
Uses the same cancellation operation as clearTimeout. Unknown numeric handles do nothing.

**Parameter `handle`**

Handle returned by setInterval.

**See also**

setInterval

**@keywords**

interval, timer, cancel, cleanup
